title: Verify: Approve, Retry and Reject 401 return to the token gate without stale action error
summary: Unit tests for 401 on all three actions and for clearing a prior action error.
description: Add tests to the existing adminActions test file using the stubActionFetch helper and fixtures from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirror the backend handlers for /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/{approve|retry|reject}.
acceptance_criteria: Retry and reject 401 each show the Admin token field with 'Invalid token'.
A prior 500 error is not shown after a 401 and token re-entry.

steps.symbol: new: it retry 401 returns to gate
steps.action: Add a test using failedExecutionFixture and stubActionFetch returning json({error:'unauthorized'},401); render AdminApp, enterToken('secret'), click the Retry button and assert findByRole('alert') has text 'Invalid token' and getByLabelText('Admin token') is present.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "retry endpoint returns 401"

steps.symbol: new: it reject 401 returns to gate
steps.action: Same as the retry test but with executionFixture status 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', clicking the Reject button.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "reject endpoint returns 401"

steps.symbol: new: it 401 clears prior action error
steps.action: Stub the approve action to return 500 {error:'boom'} on the first call and 401 on the second. Click Approve twice, enter 'secret' at the gate again, and assert that no alert with text 'boom' appears in the Execution region.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "clears prior action error"
